verdict.rationale: HashiCorp documents an official Terraform MCP server, confirmed by a probe of its docs page. It gives AI models real-time access to current provider documentation, modules, and policies from the Terraform Registry, to improve configuration generation. missing for 10: documented connection/setup instructions and client compatibility, independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully, evidence of tools beyond registry lookup (e.g., plan/state operations).
